description: Every AC ready; only the cross-midnight cap waits on F-1.

analysis.summary: Placeholder personalisation with a fallback, opt-out and self-exclusion filtering, and a daily frequency cap. Time zone of the cap and a missing bonus value are unspecified.

acceptance_criteria.text: A campaign message can contain the placeholders {first_name} and {bonus_amount}, which are replaced with the recipient's values when the message is sent.
If a recipient has no first name, {first_name} is replaced with "Player".
Recipients who opted out of marketing communication are excluded from the campaign audience.
Recipients with an active self-exclusion are never sent promotional messages.
A recipient receives at most one message from the same campaign per calendar day.

findings.text: Which time zone defines the calendar day of the frequency cap: the recipient's or the platform's?
What happens when {bonus_amount} has no value for a recipient: skip the recipient, send without it, or fail the send?
Are opt-out and self-exclusion evaluated when the audience is built or again at send time?
Which channels (email, SMS, push) are in scope?

risks.title: Self-excluded player contacted
risks.description: A promotional message reaches a self-excluded player.

risks.title: Duplicate messages
risks.description: The cap fails and recipients get several messages a day.

test_cases.title: Both placeholders are replaced with the recipient's values
preconditions: Campaign 'Weekend reload' uses the message 'Hi {first_name}, your bonus is {bonus_amount}'

steps.action: Send the campaign to recipient alex@example.com (first name Alex, bonus amount 25).
steps.expected_result: The delivered message reads 'Hi Alex, your bonus is 25'.

test_cases.title: A recipient without a first name is addressed as Player
preconditions: Campaign 'Weekend reload' uses the message 'Hi {first_name}, your bonus is {bonus_amount}'

steps.action: Send the campaign to recipient sam@example.com (no first name, bonus amount 10).
steps.expected_result: The delivered message reads 'Hi Player, your bonus is 10'.

test_cases.title: An opted-out recipient is not in the audience
preconditions: Campaign 'Weekend reload' uses the message 'Hi {first_name}, your bonus is {bonus_amount}'

steps.action: Build the audience of the campaign with recipient kim@example.com who opted out.
steps.expected_result: kim@example.com is not in the audience and receives no message.

test_cases.title: Self-exclusion and opt-in decide who is messaged
preconditions: Campaign 'Weekend reload' uses the message 'Hi {first_name}, your bonus is {bonus_amount}'

steps.action: Send the campaign to an opted-in recipient without self-exclusion.
Send the campaign to an opted-in recipient with an active self-exclusion.
Send the campaign to an opted-out recipient with an active self-exclusion.

test_cases.title: A second send of the same campaign on the same day is suppressed
test_cases.objective: AC-5: two sends one hour apart at midday are the same day in every time zone.
preconditions: Campaign 'Weekend reload' uses the message 'Hi {first_name}, your bonus is {bonus_amount}'

steps.action: Send the campaign to alex@example.com at 11:00 UTC and again at 12:00 UTC.
steps.expected_result: alex@example.com receives exactly one the campaign message.

test_cases.title: Sends 24 hours apart are both delivered
test_cases.objective: AC-5: 24 hours apart always fall on different calendar days.
preconditions: Campaign 'Weekend reload' uses the message 'Hi {first_name}, your bonus is {bonus_amount}'

steps.action: Send the campaign to alex@example.com on day 1 at 12:00 UTC and on day 2 at 12:00 UTC.
steps.expected_result: alex@example.com receives two the campaign messages, one per day.

test_cases.title: Sends around platform midnight for a recipient in another time zone
test_cases.objective: AC-5 across midnight; depends on F-1 (whose calendar day).
preconditions: Campaign 'Weekend reload' uses the message 'Hi {first_name}, your bonus is {bonus_amount}'

steps.action: Send the campaign at 23:30 and 00:30 platform time to a recipient whose time zone is UTC+2.
steps.expected_result: The number of messages delivered follows the PO answer to F-1.
